===============
# General Setup
===============

# Read in files
```{r}
megatable <- read.csv("../data/pangenome_project_megatable.csv")

strelka <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Ancestry", "Reference", "Strelka_Precision", "Strelka_Recall", "Strelka_F1_Score")]
```

# Setup
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

ancestry_colors <- c("#add8e6", "#FEF5C3", "#fdc0cb")
black_colors <- c("black", "black", "black")
```

# Useful functions
```{r}
rename_col <- function(df) {
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Recall$", colnames(df))] <- "Recall"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Precision$", colnames(df))] <- "Precision"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_F1_Score$", colnames(df))] <- "F1_Score"
  return(df)
}

as_numeric <- function(df) {
  df <- df[df$Reference %in% c("Pangenome", "Linear"), ]
  df$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df$F1_Score)
  df$Precision <- as.numeric(df$Precision)
  df$Recall <- as.numeric(df$Recall)
  return(df)
}
```

# Process
```{r}
strelka <- rename_col(strelka)
strelka <- as_numeric(strelka)
```

# Plot Template
```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)
jitterdodge <- position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)

ancestry_boxplot <- function(data, plot_title) {
  set.seed(1)
  boxplot_pan <- ggplot(data, aes(Metric, Value, fill=Ancestry)) + 
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.5,      
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,   
      alpha = 0.2,                
      fill = "grey"                
    ) +
    stat_boxplot(
      geom = "errorbar", 
      width = 0.3, 
      color = "black", 
      size = 0.6,
      position = dodge) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.6,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 1,
      color = "black",
      size = 0.6,
      position = dodge) +
    labs(
      # title = plot_title, 
      x = element_blank(), 
      y = "Metric Percentage (%)") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
      "F1_Score" = "F1 Score",
      "Precision" = "Precision",
      "Recall" = "Recall"))  +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-1, 100),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = ancestry_colors,
      name = "Ancestry",
      labels = c(
          "AA_Patients" = "African",
          "EA_Patients" = "European",
          "EAA_Patients" = "East Asian")) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = black_colors,
      name = "Ancestry",
      labels = c(
        "AA_Patients" = "African",
        "EA_Patients" = "European",
        "EAA_Patients" = "East Asian")) +
    geom_jitter(
      size = 2,
      shape = 21,
      aes(color = Ancestry),
      fill = NA,
      alpha = 0.9,
      position = jitterdodge) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 22,
                                               size = 6,
                                               fill = ancestry_colors, 
                                               color = "black")), 
      fill  = "none") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "inside",
      legend.position.inside = c(0.92, 0.15),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
      # panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black")
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.5, y = Inf,
      label = plot_title,
      size = 7,
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 2
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(1.5, 2.5), 
      linetype = "dashed", 
      color = "grey", 
      size = 0.6)
}
```


====================
# Strelka Pangenome
====================

# Plot
```{r}
strelka_pan <- strelka[strelka$Reference == "Pangenome", ]
strelka_pan$Ancestry <- factor(
  strelka_pan$Ancestry,
  levels = c("AA_Patients", "EA_Patients", "EAA_Patients")
)

strelka_long_pan <- data.frame(
  Donor_ID = rep(strelka_pan$Donor_ID, times = 3),
  Ancestry = rep(strelka_pan$Ancestry, times = 3),
  Metric = rep(c("F1_Score", "Precision", "Recall"), each = nrow(strelka_pan)),
  Value  = c(strelka_pan$F1_Score, strelka_pan$Precision, strelka_pan$Recall)
)

strelka_pan_out <- ancestry_boxplot(strelka_long_pan, "Strelka Pangenome")

strelka_pan_out
```

# Save
```{r}
# Change directory when on cluster!!!!!!
ggsave("./plot/figure2_ancestry_boxplot_strelka_pangenome.pdf", strelka_pan_out, width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

mutect <- read.table("/workspace/lab/houlahanlab/phamc20/data/Stats_Summary/Mutect2/mega_stats_table.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

)
